$comment: Machine-readable adversarial review of an AI-executed work item (Milestone 8.1).
This file is CANDIDATE EVIDENCE, not an approval. A verdict recorded here
never changes a validator exit code and never substitutes for a human
approval row in PROJECT.md. See pmo-config/adversarial-review-policy.json
and docs/architecture/adversarial-review.md for the full design.
provenance.tier determines whether this artifact can satisfy Strict on its
own: artifact-observed cannot (needs a human review-evidence-accepted
claim in decision-log.md); externally-observed and human-attested can,
provided their required bindings hold -- see AREV-003/AREV-004.
Finding status authority is by ROLE, not by reviewer_kind: the executor
may only move a finding from open to disputed, never to any closure
state, and a finding under a human-only category (security, legal,
business, privacy) may only be closed by a human citing a decision
record. See closure_policy in the policy file and AREV-006.
Every finding must carry the M3 semantic output contract (AREV-007):
requirement_ref naming a REQ-### declared in PROJECT.md In Scope,
implementation_claim/test_claim -- or the explicit N/A marker declared
in pmo-config/adversarial-review-policy.json output_contract.n_a_marker
when the finding has no natural claim to make -- and owner, the named
human accountable for the finding (a group name is not a name). See
AREV-007.
Remove this $comment block in a real project file.
contract_sha256: <sha256 of the EXECUTION-CONTRACT.json this review covers>
base_sha: <base commit the contract was exported against>

provenance.$check_run_id_note: Required, and independently queried, when tier is externally-observed.

findings.implementation_claim: <One sentence: what this finding claims about the implementation, or N/A>
findings.test_claim: <One sentence: what this finding claims about the tests, or N/A>
findings.owner: <Named human accountable for this finding -- a group name or TBD is not a name>
findings.description: <What is wrong, in one or two sentences. Do not quote source or requirement content verbatim.>
findings.suggestion: <The concrete change that would resolve it.>
findings.$decision_ref_note: Required for false_positive, accepted_risk, or deferred. Must lead with a resolvable DEC-### that carries an axiom-authority: type=review-finding-disposition binding.

recommendation.$comment: A recommendation, not a verdict. A human decides whether to act on it.
recommendation.$verdict_options_note: approve | request_changes -- never authoritative; AREV-* never reads this field to decide pass/fail.
recommendation.notes: <One paragraph: what a reader most needs to know before acting on this review.>
